d.chapter: Economic Geography — Sectors of the Economy
d.notions: Secondary sector, industry, manufacturing, processing, construction, energy production.
d.focus: Definition and examples of the secondary sector, with examples from Cameroon.
d.competence: Learners are able to recognise the products of Cameroonian factories and explain why transforming raw materials creates jobs and wealth.
objectives: Give examples of industries in Cameroon and explain their importance.
recall: The primary sector takes raw materials from nature.
Its activities are agriculture, livestock rearing, fishing, forestry and mining.
d.recallNote: Check the homework: two factories in Cameroon and their products.
situation: Cameroon sells raw cotton and cocoa beans abroad at low prices. Later, it buys back clothes and chocolate made from them at high prices.
Djibrilla wonders why Cameroon does not transform more of its own raw materials.
sitQA: What is the problem raised in the situation above?
The problem is that Cameroon sells raw materials cheaply and buys back expensive finished goods made from them.
Which raw materials and finished goods are mentioned?
Raw cotton and cocoa beans are raw materials. Clothes and chocolate are finished goods.
What can Cameroon do to earn more from its raw materials?
It can build more factories to transform its cotton, cocoa and other raw materials into finished goods.
d.justification: This lesson will help us to understand the secondary sector, which transforms raw materials and creates jobs and wealth.

qa.q: A factory turns cotton into cloth, and another turns cocoa into chocolate. What sector do these factories belong to?
qa.a: They belong to the secondary sector, which transforms raw materials into finished goods.

sum.title: I. Definition
defs: The secondary sector is the sector of the economy that transforms raw materials into finished goods, and includes construction and energy production.

qa.q: Name two factories found in North Cameroon and what they produce.
qa.a: SODECOTON gins cotton and makes cooking oil (Diamaor), CICAM in Garoua makes cloth, and Cimencam at Figuil makes cement.

qa.q: Name two big industries found in the south of Cameroon.
qa.a: Alucam at Edéa makes aluminium, SONARA at Limbe refines oil, and the Brasseries du Cameroun make drinks.

qa.q: Building houses, roads and bridges also belongs to the secondary sector. Why?
qa.a: Because construction transforms materials such as cement, sand and iron into buildings and roads.

qa.q: The Lagdo and Edéa dams produce electricity. Why is energy important for industry?
qa.a: Factories need electricity to run their machines. Without energy, industry cannot develop.

sum.title: II. Examples of Secondary Activities
sum.intro: The main secondary activities, with examples from Cameroon, are the following:
items: A. Agro-Industries
Agro-industries transform farm products: SODECOTON (cotton and oil), CICAM (cloth), and the breweries (drinks).
B. Heavy Industries
Heavy industries transform minerals: Alucam at Edéa (aluminium), SONARA at Limbe (oil refining), Cimencam (cement).
C. Construction
Construction is the building of houses, roads, bridges and dams.
D. Energy Production
Electricity is produced by dams such as Edéa, Song Loulou, Lagdo and Lom Pangar, and by gas and thermal plants.
E. Crafts
Craftsmen such as tailors, blacksmiths, carpenters and potters make goods by hand.

evaluation: The secondary sector is the sector that transforms raw materials into finished goods.
Give one example of an agro-industry and one of a heavy industry in Cameroon.
SODECOTON is an agro-industry, and Alucam at Edéa is a heavy industry.
Why is it better for Cameroon to transform its raw materials?
It creates jobs and earns more money, because finished goods are sold at higher prices.
remediation: The sector that transforms raw materials is the ______ sector.
The factory that makes cloth in Garoua is ______.
The aluminium factory at Edéa is ______.
The oil refinery at Limbe is ______.
The building of houses and roads is called ______.
A dam on the Benue that produces electricity is ______.
d.remediationAnswers: 1. secondary 2. CICAM 3. Alucam 4. SONARA 5. construction 6. Lagdo
